(b) floor.py uses only the stdlib plus the launch tool (venv_bin_dir, runs_shell_scripts, elevation), whose imports are stdlib-only. (c) The Windows POSIX-names lay-down (bin -> Scripts, python3.exe) is not ported: it exists for bash launchers, and launch.runs_shell_scripts() is false on the box that needs it. (d) The sudo apt python3-venv repair keeps today's rule: only where launch.elevation() says ok; its password channel (CAIRN_SUDO_PW + SUDO_ASKPASS) stays the caller's, floor.py runs `sudo -n` or `sudo -A` only when the environment already carries them.
